Policy 

An undergraduate student’s request to enroll for more than 4 units must be approved by either the department chair of the student’s major, or by an advisor, based on the reviewer pre-selected by each College. In general, only students with strong academic records, not on Probation, are allowed to enroll for more than the maximum.
